stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy is preparing a new prescription for delivery to a patient's home. To satisfy the counseling-offer requirement for off-site delivery, the pharmacy provides access to its toll-free service that connects the patient with a pharmacist. Before the prescription is sent, which additional step is required under Massachusetts law?

choices.text: Print the toll-free service number on a label affixed to each prescription drug container.
Place the number only on the outer shipping package, as long as it remains visible until opening.
Include the number only on the delivery receipt that the patient signs.
Send the number in an electronic message after the package has been delivered.
Replace the toll-free number with the dispensing pharmacy's ordinary local number on the container label.

explanation.core_reasoning: When a patient elects delivery at a location other than a pharmacy, M.G.L. c.94C, §21A allows the section's requirements to be satisfied by access to a toll-free telephone service facilitating communication with the pharmacist. The statute also requires that toll-free service number to be printed on a label affixed to each prescription drug container. Outer-package, receipt, post-delivery message, or local-number substitutes do not meet that specified container-label step.

choice_analysis.A: Correct. Section 21A requires the toll-free service number on a label affixed to each prescription drug container for off-site delivery.
choice_analysis.B: The statute specifies the prescription drug container label, not only the outer shipping package.
choice_analysis.C: A delivery receipt does not substitute for the required label on each prescription drug container.
choice_analysis.D: Sending the number after delivery does not satisfy the required container-label placement before the prescription reaches the patient.
choice_analysis.E: The statute calls for the toll-free service number used for this remote counseling-access pathway; an ordinary local number is not the specified substitute.

explanation.mpje_trap: Do not confuse supplying remote telephone access with placing the required toll-free number on each prescription container.

reasoning_steps: Recognize home delivery as a prescription delivered to a location other than the pharmacy
Apply the toll-free pharmacist-access pathway to the counseling-offer requirement
Verify that the toll-free service number is printed on each prescription drug container label
